title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 173
paragraphs: Bordering on the Nasamones is the country of the Psylli. These have utterly perished in the following way. The south wind blowing on them dried up all their water-cisterns, and their land became waterless, lying as it does wholly within the Syrtis. By common decision they took up arms and marched against the south wind—I report what the Libyans report—and when they had reached the sandy tract, the south wind blew and buried them in the sand. Having utterly perished, their land from that time onward has been held by the Nasamones.
